duke-designer.title: Brand Design Example
duke-designer.summary: Turn a public brand guide into a repeatable design practice for your agent.
duke-designer.description: A working example of a skill that applies one specific public brand guide to artifact creation and review. It brings color, typography, composition, and accessibility guidance into the task, with references the agent can consult as needed.
duke-designer.inputs: A content brief, intended audience, output format, and any authorized assets. The skill uses its bundled brand guidance; it is not a universal brand-system generator.
duke-designer.outputs: Designed webpages, slide decks, documents, and visual materials, plus a review of design decisions and remaining limitations. File creation and rendering use your agent’s available tools.
duke-designer.sample: Create a one-page overview for a community research workshop. Use the bundled color and typography guidance, clear reading order, and accessible contrast. Keep the text neutral, use no logos, and label it as an independent demonstration.
